## Objective

Describe the technical problem or gap (not a vague wish list).

## Proposed solution

Clear description of the desired API, mode, profile, test, or build change.

## Implementation considerations

- Fit with MCU defaults (CTR default; other modes opt-in)
- Code size / RAM / stack impact
- Compatibility with existing `AES_*` APIs and status codes
- Sister-project alignment ([tiny-DES-c](https://github.com/mistial-dev/tiny-DES-c))

## Testing / validation

How the change would be verified (unit tests, CAVP, Wycheproof, size).

## Additional context

Links to standards, vectors, or prior discussion.

Requests must support the library’s technical goals.
